description: Repository class for managing organization attribute options, including CRUD operations, assignment to users, and filtering, within a NestJS application using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: OrganizationAttributeOptionRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling organization attribute options, including CRUD, assignment, and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: createOrganizationAttributeOption
methods.description: Creates a new attribute option for an organization.

methods.name: deleteOrganizationAttributeOption
methods.description: Deletes an attribute option by ID, with error handling if not found.

methods.name: getOrganizationAttributeOptions
methods.description: Retrieves attribute options for a specific organization and attribute.

methods.name: getOrganizationAttributeOptionsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves attribute options assigned to a user within an organization.

methods.name: getOrganizationAttributeAssignedOptions
methods.description: Retrieves attribute options with filtering by attribute ID, slug, organization, and user assignment.

methods.name: assignOrganizationAttributeOptionToUser
methods.description: Assigns an attribute option to a user, creating a dynamic option if needed.

methods.name: createDynamicAttributeOption
methods.description: Creates a new attribute option with a slugified value.

methods.name: unassignOrganizationAttributeOptionFromUser
methods.description: Removes an attribute option assignment from a user.
